entry: Long: the previous candle was bearish, closed below the lower band, and had RSI below 30; the current candle is bullish and closes back above the lower band.
Short: the previous candle was bullish, closed above the upper band, and had RSI above 70; the current candle is bearish and closes back below the upper band.
exit: Take profit at 3 x ATR(14) from the entry close.
stop_loss: Stop at 2 x ATR(14) from the entry close.
filters: Bollinger Bands use a 20-period SMA with 2.0 standard deviations. RSI length is 14.
Optional filters are off by default: bandwidth above 0.3, a breakout filter, and a 50-candle maximum hold.
